description: This file is a Perl script designed for manipulating NSLU2 firmware images, including reading, writing, parsing, and constructing firmware partitions and images.

methods.name: padBytes
methods.description: Pads the input data to a specified total length with 0xFF bytes.

methods.name: paddedSize
methods.description: Returns the next multiple of block_size greater than or equal to a given data length.

methods.name: numBlocks
methods.description: Calculates the number of blocks required to hold the given data length.

methods.name: createPartitionEntry
methods.description: Creates a binary representation of a partition entry for RedBoot and FIS directory.

methods.name: parsePartitionEntry
methods.description: Parses a partition entry binary blob into a structured array with name, address, size, and skips.

methods.name: findPartitionTable
methods.description: Checks for and extracts the partition table from firmware data.

methods.name: parsePartitionTable
methods.description: Parses the partition table into individual partition entries.

methods.name: jffs2Block
methods.description: Creates an empty JFFS2 flash block.

methods.name: trailerData
methods.description: Constructs trailer data for Sercomm devices.

methods.name: printRedbootTrailer
methods.description: Prints formatted information from the RedBoot trailer data.

methods.name: removeOptionalLoader
methods.description: Removes the Loader partition and adjusts Kernel/Ramdisk offsets.

methods.name: spliceFirmwarePartitions
methods.description: Reads partition information from firmware buffer and updates partition list.

methods.name: buildPartitionTable
methods.description: Builds the binary partition table from current partitions.

methods.name: writeOutFirmware
methods.description: Writes the entire firmware image from partitions into a file.

methods.name: checkPartitionTable
methods.description: Performs a sanity check on a partition table.

methods.name: printPartitions
methods.description: Prints a human-readable list of partitions.

methods.name: defaultPartitions
methods.description: Returns a default set of firmware partitions.

methods.name: layoutPartitions
methods.description: Calculates and assigns start addresses and sizes to partitions based on firmware layout constraints.
